newsitem.title: USA: DePuy Inc files for 14.8 mln share IPO.
newsitem.headline: DePuy Inc files for 14.8 mln share IPO.

text.p: DePuy Inc said it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering of 14.8 million shares of common stock.

The stock is being offered by both DePuy and Corange Limited, the parent company of the Boehringer Mannheim Group, a European-based pharmaceutical, chemical and diagnostic company, DePuy said in a statement released late Wednesday.
Upon completion of the offering, Corange and its subsidiaries will continue to own about 84.8 percent of the common stock of DePuy, the company said.
The offering price is expected to be between $16.50 and $18.50 a share, said DePuy. The company manufactures orthopedic devices.
Morgan Stanley & Co Inc is the lead manager for the proposed offering. Bear Stearns & Co Inc, Cowen & Co, and Furman-Selz are co-managers of the offering.
